free_tier.stated: Kilo Code: the platform is free for individuals at USD 0; free models (Auto Free, `kilo-auto/free`, and models marked free) are billed at USD 0 and rate-limited to 200 requests per hour per IP; paid inference is at provider rates with no markup, plus a 5% payment-processing fee on credit purchases

interface_detail: the `kilo` CLI and the IDE extensions; the Kilo Gateway takes OpenAI-SDK and Vercel AI SDK requests with an API key; not probed
tooling: the open-source Kilo Code agent for VS Code and JetBrains, the `kilo` CLI, and Cloud Agents in a Kilo-hosted Linux container; models come from the Kilo Gateway, from the user's own keys for over 30 providers, or from a linked ChatGPT subscription
chaining: a free VS Code agent with a free-model route is a $0 front end to whichever inference vendor is giving tokens away, so it inherits that vendor's quota and needs no card of its own.

limits.value: free models: 200 requests per hour per IP address, for anonymous and authenticated requests alike; over the limit the gateway answers HTTP 429

limits_note: free models: 200 requests per hour per IP; paid models are not rate-limited by the gateway, only by the balance and by upstream providers
binding_note: the 200 requests per hour per IP on free models binds first; paid models have no gateway rate limit and stop at a zero balance with HTTP 402

identity_cost.detail: an account: sign-in is by email address, ChatGPT, Google, Apple, GitHub, GitLab, Discord, LinkedIn, Anaconda or organisation single sign-on, and the free-models page says no credit card is required for free models; the provider page also names a temporary hold as identity verification without saying when it applies. At the gateway, free-model requests are served to anonymous callers too, rate-limited by IP.

notes: A coding subscription in part: Kilo Code is an open-source coding agent whose platform is free for individuals, with Teams at USD 15 a user a month and Kilo Pass, a monthly AI token subscription with up to 50% bonus credits. No coding-subs record holds it; inference/kilo-gateway holds the gateway's free models. It stays in compute for Cloud Agents, an isolated Linux container billed per second from USD 0.60 an hour, separate from inference, which needs a USD 5 balance present to start. The free model list changes as provider promotions end.
